scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && node docker/repair-dev-networks.cjs
scripts.docker:dev:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build && node docker/repair-dev-networks.cjs
scripts.docker:dev:install: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps -e CI=true frontend pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir=/root/.local/share/pnpm/store && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart backend-api-auth backend-api-gateway backend-api-partner frontend && node docker/repair-dev-networks.cjs
